alignments.note: Attributive participle rendered as a finite relative clause; the supplied relativizer and copula are helpers on the participle (rules 7, 9, 31), headed on the lexical verb.
Correlative men written out as indeed (rule 70).
Greek anarthrous, so the supplied determiner is an ordinary helper on the noun it determines (rules 51, 58).
Anarthrous genitive rendered of the world; no article competes, so the determiner and case preposition ride with the noun (rules 21, 51).
Auxiliary rides with the participle; head on the lexical verb (rules 9, 17).

Substantival superlative rendered the end; it is the nominal word and takes the supplied determiner itself, the following article governing chronon (rule 58). Giving the to the article and a bare end here remains defensible.
Article carries the case preposition, one unit headed on the (rule 21).
Discontinuous for ... sake wrap around an expressed Greek preposition heads on the prepositional word (rule 78).
The pronoun is what the possessive your realizes.
